description: Ayanna Howard is dean of The Ohio State University’s College of Engineering, an IEEE Senior Member, and a top expert on two of the most hyped fields in tech: humanoid robots and artificial intelligence. Combining these technologies could allow advanced bots to take on all sorts of tasks , from helping pack boxes at warehouses, to taking care of the elderly, or even doing the dishes . But what will it take to get there, and how close are we to getting everyday robot helpers? Howard speaks to WSJ’…
classificationReason: Entire episode focuses on humanoid robots, AI integration, practical applications, and the gap between hype and deployment.
qualityReason: Features a prominent robotics and AI expert in a focused interview discussing technical and societal readiness.
